U1A = CH0 input buffer        U1B = CH0 divider buffer (new)
U2A = CH0 SK active filter    U2B = CH1 input buffer
U3A = CH1 divider buffer (new) U3B = CH1 SK active filter
U4A = CH2 input buffer        U4B = CH2 divider buffer (new)
U5A = CH2 SK active filter    U5B = CH3 input buffer

Notes:
- Rev 2 adds a unity-gain divider buffer (B-unit) between the ÷4 attenuator
and the Sallen-Key filter. This eliminates Rth = 7.5kΩ source loading that
was shifting fn from ideal 4.95 kHz down to 3.74 kHz in Rev 1.
- IC count increases from 5 to 8 TL072 SOIC-8 (or 4× TL074 quad SOIC-14).
- C0G/NP0 caps mandatory for SK filter; X7R/Y5V will detune cutoff
- TL072 can be substituted with TL082 or OPA2134 (lower noise)
- BAT54 can be substituted with BAT54S (dual in SOT-23) to halve clamp count
- All op-amps share ±9V rails (same as Chua circuit supply)
- ADS1262 AVDD/AVSS (±2.5V) supplied separately from RP2350 board or LDO
Filter design (per channel — Rev 2  fn = ideal with buffer):
Topology: Unity-gain Sallen-Key 2nd-order Butterworth LPF
Source impedance of SK input: 0Ω (driven by TL072 divider buffer)
R_SK1 = R_SK2 = 10kΩ  (R1_eff = R_SK1 = 10kΩ — no source loading)
C_SK_FB = 2.2nF  (node-A to output)
C_SK_SH = 4.7nF  (non-inv input to GND)
fn = 1/(2π×10k×sqrt(2.2n×4.7n)) = 4.95 kHz  (restored to ideal) ✓
Attenuator:
